thread:
maria_support: Hey team — multiple customers hitting 502/503 from hosted inference since ~07:12 UTC. Customers report generation calls failing intermittently, high error rate in dashboards. I grabbed a few request ids: req_01A, req_01B, req_01C.

omar_sre: seeing it in infra alerts too. Control-plane 5xx spikes in the routing-policy service and session/auth timeouts. Metrics show routing-policy latency spike ~500ms -> 3s and a burst of DB timeouts to config-db at 07:11.

lucy_platform: are these user-facing errors or internal fallbacks? Any automatic retries?

maria_support: user-facing — API returns 502 with body: {\"error\":\"control-plane: routing-policy timeout\"}. No consistent retries from clients. Some customers reported billing errors too (failed op records).

andre_engineer: logs from routing-policy show stack like: ``ERROR routing: failed eval policy: context deadline exceeded (db=postgres-config pool exhausted)``. Config DB connections spiked then started returning 5xx.

sre-oncall: I just paged eng-runtime. Quick checks: connection pool metrics on pg-config show maxed at 500/500, a bunch of idle connections in TIME_WAIT. We might have a connection leak or a sudden query storm (policy evaluation).

maria_support: repro steps from a customer: ``curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/fast-generate/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":20}'`` -> 502 with body above. Happened ~5/10 attempts for them.

omar_sre: tried reproducing from prod: 1) ran same curl 20x from us-west -> intermittent 502s. 2) grabbed trace id and traced upstream: control-plane -> routing-policy -> config-db and auth-session service both returned errors around same timestamps.

lucy_platform: does routing-policy have a fallback if DB unavailable?

andre_engineer: currently routing-policy will try cache then DB; if DB times out it returns error up the chain (we don't have graceful degrade to a default policy for safety). We can flip a feature flag to short-circuit routing-policy to a conservative default while we root-cause.

maria_support: customers need mitigation ASAP. Any quick action to reduce user impact?

omar_sre: mitigation suggestions: 1) increase postgres connection limit and restart routing-policy pods in a rolling manner to clear leaked connections (risky). 2) enable routing-policy short-circuit FG flag (low-risk, immediate). 3) throttle expensive evals via api-gateway rate-limit for affected tenants (requires config change).

andre_engineer: I'll prepare a short-circuit flag change and a DB pool increase. Lucy, can you approve a controlled rollout (canary 10% then 100%)?

lucy_platform: approve canary and monitor latency/error dashboards. Start canary now. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy request created by andre_engineer: deploy/routing-policy/shortcircuit-v1 -> canary(10%). CI passed.

support-bot: Notifying affected customers list (customer-a, customer-b) with interim status and ETA.

maria_support: sending customer notes: "We're aware of intermittent 502/503 errors caused by internal control-plane dependency timeouts (routing-policy/config-db). We're enabling a short-circuit to reduce failures; we'll follow up with root cause and a timeline."

omar_sre: can people grab pprof and active query stats from postgres at 07:11 window? I captured a slow-query sample showing nested policy rule joins ~200ms each and many parallel queries. Suspect recent policy rollout increased cardinality.

andre_engineer: rolling out short-circuit now. Monitoring logs...

(10s later) andre_engineer: canary healthy. Errors dropped from 14% -> 1.2% for canary tenants. Starting 50% then full.

lucy_platform: I'm monitoring traces and cost dashboard. Also rolling a small connection-pool bump on postgres (from 500->700) to drain backlog. Need DB team signoff for permanent increase.

maria_support: customers replied acknowledging the interim fix, asked for RCA and ETA. I'll keep them posted.

omar_sre: next steps for postmortem: - gather policy-change diffs from the friday rollout - DB slow query logs around 07:10-07:15 - heap/pprof for routing-policy replicas - audit connection pool metrics and client drivers for leaks - consider default-policy fallback for safety.

andre_engineer: filed an issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2247 (root-cause analysis + remediation). Assigning to lucy and omar.

sre-oncall: still monitoring; errors back to normal after short-circuit. Leaving oncall watch for 2 hours.

maria_support: thanks everyone — I'm updating customers and will post follow-up here with RCA link. :heart:

(End of thread)
